products.html:
Overview

A rechargeable waist belt that combines adjustable warmth with vibration. Its lavender front unit has a black digital display and sits on an adjustable grey strap for use around the waist.

Features

  • Rechargeable design for cordless use.
  • Heating and vibration functions.
  • Adjustable waist strap.
  • Digital display and simple controls.

Product details

Product typeRechargeable waist warming belt
Colour shownLavender with grey strap
FunctionsHeating and vibration
FitAdjustable waist strap
Pack quantity1 belt

Included item

One heating belt with its waist strap. Confirm the packed charging accessories before ordering.

How to use

  1. Read the supplied instructions before charging or first use.
  2. Charge using the connection and power source specified in those instructions.
  3. Position the belt around the waist and adjust the strap for a comfortable fit.
  4. Use the controls to select the setting described in the instructions. Stop if the belt feels uncomfortable or too warm.
  5. Switch off after use.

Care

Switch off and disconnect before cleaning. Keep the electronic unit and charging connection dry. Follow the supplied cleaning instructions; do not assume that the complete unit can be washed or immersed.

products.html:
Overview

A compact USB rechargeable scalp massager with a rounded white shell, silver trim and four grey massage heads. The handheld design has a single top button for operation.

Features

  • Four detachable massage heads with soft silicone bristles.
  • USB rechargeable for cordless use.
  • Rounded handheld body.
  • One-button control.
  • Detachable heads provide access for cleaning.

Product details

Product typeElectric scalp massager
Colour shownWhite with silver trim and grey heads
BodyPlastic, as listed by the supplier
Massage bristlesSilicone, as listed by the supplier
Heads4 detachable massage heads
PowerUSB rechargeable
ControlOne top button
Pack quantity1 massager

Included item

One scalp massager with four massage heads. Confirm the packed charging accessories before ordering.

How to use

  1. Read the supplied instructions and charge as directed before use.
  2. Hold the unit comfortably and use the top button as instructed.
  3. Place the heads gently against the scalp and move slowly without pressing hard.
  4. Stop if it catches the hair or causes discomfort.
  5. Switch off after use.

Care

Switch off and disconnect before cleaning. The supplier recommends wiping the silicone heads with a damp cloth and avoiding harsh chemicals. Follow the supplied instructions for removing and refitting heads. Keep the body and charging connection dry; do not immerse the unit or assume it is suitable for shower use.
